name: gcc
purpose: GNU C Compiler — compile C source code into an executable machine-code binary.
explanation: Translates an entire C source file into machine code before execution (Compilation path in C07), producing an executable binary (default `a.out`, or custom name via `-o`).
explanationOfOutput: `gcc` produces binary `hello`; `./hello` executes it directly on the CPU.

beforeAfterState.after: Compiled executable `hello` is created with execute permission.

whenToUse: When compiling C programs into native machine-code executables.
commonMistakes: Trying to run `hello.c` directly without compiling it first.
commonErrors: error: expected ';' before '}' token (compile-time syntax error)
